name: Backup freshness
desc: Checks that the backup folders you list got new files recently. Report only.
prompt: For each selected host, check each watched path with files.changed_within and days 2. A path with no files changed in the last 2 days is stale: say so clearly. If a path is fresh, say how many files changed. If a host has no watched paths, say they can be added under Agent policy.
